main_text.l: ET de primo quidem non magnopere censeo laborandum; Potest sane Deus efficere, vt commoretur lupus cum agno, & pardus cum haedo recubet; Quàm facilè ipsi est adamantina hominum pectora conspersò immaculati illius agni sanguine sic emollire, vt in merum amorem liquefiant; sed vt nunc sunt tempora, non minori hercle miraculo foret, charitatem in nos Pontificiam experiri, quàm leones Danieli amicè

page.notes: Catchword "ad-" is the start of the next page's first word, printed at the foot right of the column. The marginal note "Esa.11.6." is the reference beside the line "cum agno". Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored.
